text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: The day of the Tenno Sho (Autumn)—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: ...A heavy downpour.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Without even waiting for the official announcement...
this track is definitely going to be heavy, no doubt about it.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: The ground must have absorbed quite a lot of water and gotten heavy, and—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Our Tenno Sho (Autumn) is late in the day,
meaning after several races have already been run."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Taking the inside course that everyone is aiming for
is already just..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
A complete, muddy mess, I imagine.
...It'd be weirder if it *didn't* trip you up.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod while glancing at the monitor in the waiting room.
On screen, footage from a previous race is playing, but—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Faced with a course turned into a muddy quagmire,
it was already clear that she was being forced to take a safe racing line.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"...Shall we also review
your rivals, then?"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: The one we must be most wary of is, of course—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Indeed. That's right.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I made sure to check on her, including how she did during summer camp...
And well, she's definitely improving—at quite a fierce pace, too~

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: And on top of that, she started getting proper rest, so she even became consistent.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Do you think all the things I told her
after the Takarazuka Kinen were uncalled for?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Ahaha!
...Well, jokes aside.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
To be frank, how much this heavy track
will hinder Kitasan remains unknown—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Normally, for a girl with a huge stride like hers,
wet turf should be a slippery disadvantage.
Yet even with that, it's finally... a 50/50."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
If Kitasan powers through even the heavy turf
and pulls off a runaway lead, catching her will be difficult.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
And that's where things stand, but—
Come on, Trainer.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: Could you let me hear what you think?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod, looking straight back
into Satono Crown's sharp, intelligent eyes.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The strategy had been decided.
Perhaps from the very moment I looked up at the rain drops
falling relentlessly from the heavy, stagnant morning sky.
choice_data_list: The greatest return requires the greatest risk.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The first strategy—it goes against the conventional theory.
Plunging straight through the innermost lane, where the track condition is at its absolute worst.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as Satono Crown said earlier,
the inside course has turned into a terrible quagmire.
Pushing through here would be utter madness."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Normally, one would avoid risk.
Even if taking a wider turn, one would stick to the safe path,
prioritizing safety over distance.
choice_data_list: That's precisely why we're doing the exact opposite.
That's precisely why we're doing the exact opposite.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: With a powerhouse like Kitasan Black, there's a strong chance she won't hesitate to dive inside... But if so, I'll cut even further inside.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Plunging to the innermost rail, the riskiest path.
—Aiming for the shortest distance to victory.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
It is obvious.
And that is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I take it this proposal comes with absolute confidence?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I nod without a moment's hesitation.
Satono Crown breaks into a grin.
choice_data_list: You're an "expert on bad tracks," aren't you?
You're an "expert on bad tracks," aren't you?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The strategy was already decided.
I was certain of it.
choice_data_list: If it's you, a little adversity like this won't hold you back.
If it's you, this kind of adversity won't faze you at all.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Ahahahahaha!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Perfect-ya!
Sounds great, it's the ultimate plan!"

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Now, what else?
Could you tell me how to shoulder the maximum risk
even if we fail to secure the innermost lane?

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
Pile on your expectations, your trust, all of it.
I'll carry as much as you can throw at me.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Channeling all of that into power, I will win!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Ah, Kura-chan!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Aha, it's really pouring.
We just stepped outside, but we're already soaked!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
You're right.
But Kitasan, you—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"Her soul hasn't cooled down one bit.
At least, that's how it looks to me."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yeah, of course!!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You feel it too, don't you, Kura-chan?
You're excited. Your heart is racing!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hey, Kura-chan!!
Let's put on a race even more amazing than the Takarazuka Kinen, okay?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Let's burn brightly together!
—And in the end, I'll be the winner!!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I agree with you up to a point♪

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: —Yet at the end, I won't yield. No way.

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text: I'm going to turn the tables on you, Kitasan!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Ah, there you are! Cheval!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: Why are you so restless? Let's get back to our seats, okay? Post time is coming up.

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: Ah...

text_block_list.name: Cheval Grand
text_block_list.text: I... I'm going to watch from down below after all!!

text_block_list.name: Verxina
text_block_list.text: !? Cheval—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The Tenno Sho (Autumn).
Amidst the flying mud, a clash with their pride on the line begins right now...!
